videos.title: The Dukes of Hazzard
videos.description: The Dukes have to protect a young lady from being caught by Boss Hogg, who suspects she knows about his motorcycle theft ring, during the annual Hazzard Motocross Race.

videos.title: The Dukes of Hazzard
videos.description: When Boss Hogg is arrested for burgling his own bank, Uncle Jesse bails out, but questions are raised whether Boss really robbed the bank at all.

videos.description: Boss's rich nephew, Jamie Lee Hogg, a counterfeiter, arrives in Hazzard and begins a romance with Daisy Duke.

videos.title: Gunsmoke: The Long Ride
videos.description: At the wedding of his daughter (Amy Stock-Poynton), retired marshal Matt Dillon (James Arness) is shockingly charged with a murder he did not commit. Instead of a honeymoon, the newlyweds must instead flee with Dillon and try to help him clear his name by finding the real murderer. As a bounty-hunting posse pursues hot on their heels, the trio receives help from two unlikely sources: prostitute Uncle Jane Merkel (Ali MacGraw) and preacher John Parsley (James Brolin).

videos.title: The Savage
videos.description: Jim is a White man who was raised as an American Indian by the Sioux tribe and renamed War Bonnet. However, an impending war makes him question his loyalty to his adopted family.

videos.title: Sitting Bull
videos.description: A cavalry major is accused of being a traitor because of his sympathetic attitude toward the Indians.

videos.title: Eagle's Wing
videos.description: This lyrical western, set among the savage landscape of canyons and plains of New Mexico, features Martin Sheen as city-bred Pike who travels to the badlands with experienced trapper Henry to buy pelts from a Comanche chief.

videos.description: A space commander returns from a 30-year mission and finds that his girlfriend hasn't aged.

videos.description: A man with a violent past seeks revenge for the murder of his son, a police officer who was gunned down in a drive-by shooting. In his desperate hunt for the killer, he makes some dangerous enemies.

The younger is determined to search the wreckage for money and valuables, while the elder, a retired mountaineer, wants only to look out for his brother's safety, but once at the crash site, the brothers fight over the fate of the only survivor, a Hindu girl.

videos.title: Wanted
videos.description: Wesley Gibson is an office worker whose life is going nowhere. After his estranged father is murdered, he meets Fox, who recruits him into the Fraternity, a secret society of assassins which takes its orders from Fate itself. Fox and Sloan, the Fraternity's leader, teach Wesley to tap into dormant powers. Though he enjoys his newfound abilities, he begins to suspect that there is more to the Fraternity than meets the eye.

videos.title: Acts of Violence
videos.description: Three Midwestern brothers, a crime lord, and an incorruptible police officer are on a deadly collision course when the youngest brother's fiancée is kidnapped by human traffickers. videos.title: Pistol Whipped
videos.description: Following an elite ex-cop kicked off the force amid accusations of theft. Troubled by heavy gambling debts and alcoholism, the man is offered salvation by a mysterious stranger who requests just a few favours in return. In exchange for freedom from debt, the former officer must dispatch some of the city's toughest criminals. However, the arrangement hits a snag when the name of a police detective appears on the hit list.

videos.title: Desperado
videos.description: The sequel to 'El Mariachi', the film continues the story of the no-name, solitary, brooding mariachi, whose guitar case is stocked with high-powered weaponry. The musician is in a sleepy Mexican town seeking revenge against the much-feared, ruthless Bucho, a drug dealer who once shot El Mariachi in his strumming hand, and killed his girlfriend.

videos.title: Renegades
videos.description: On assignment in war-torn Europe, Navy SEALs discover gold at the bottom of a lake - a fortune rumoured to be worth hundreds of millions of dollars. When the enemy detects the team, the SEALs are left with only 10 hours to recover the treasure.

videos.title: The Most Dangerous Game
videos.description: A father and son are shipwrecked on a remote island where they are caught up in a trophy hunt held by its mysterious owner, a merciless man who uses the land as an elite hunting preserve for stalking the most dangerous game of all: humans.
